title: Unsupervised Learning for Automated Detection of Coronary Artery Disease Subgroups.
summary: Unsupervised learning on clinical data identified coronary-artery-disease subgroups, within the scope and limitations the paper states. The subgroups are data-derived patterns; they do not establish causal subtypes or prospective clinical benefit.
